body:
# BGM Backport

Bring all new background music from Minecraft 1.21.6+ into your 1.21.1 game. This lightweight, client-side resource pack replaces vanilla tracks with the latest versions, preserving original audio quality and scene matching. No mods required.

---

## Features
- ✅ Full 1.21.1 compatibility
- 🎵 Includes all 1.21.6+ new tracks
- 🔊 Uncompressed audio quality
- ⚡ No performance impact
- 🧩 Works with vanilla & modded

## Notes
- Client-side only, no server setup needed
- Place at the top of your resource pack list
- All music belongs to Mojang Studios; fan-made for personal use
- The lossless audio quality version requires the installation of a resource pack decoding module; otherwise, the resource pack will be invalid

---

# 背景音乐兼容包

将我的世界 1.21.6 及以上版本新增背景音乐，移植适配 1.21.1 版本。
轻量客户端材质包，原版曲目替换为最新音频，音质无损、场景适配，无需安装模组。

---

## Features
- ✅ 完美兼容 1.21.1 版本
- 🎵 收录全部 1.21.6 + 新增配乐
- 🔊 音频无压缩，原声画质
- ⚡ 零性能占用，运行流畅
- 🧩 原版 / 模组客户端均可使用

## 使用须知
- 仅客户端生效，无需服务器配置
- 将材质包置顶启用列表
- 音乐版权归 Mojang 工作室所有，仅供个人爱好者使用
- 无损音质版需要安装资源包解码模组，否则资源包无效
